summary: Frontend-only test of RobotBoogiePage head-clipping fix (iteration 16). Empirically measured every visible sprite against its parent motion.button at n=1,3,4,5,6,8. HEAD CLIPPING IS FIXED at every count (clip_events=[] everywhere — no img.top is above btn.top). HOWEVER a new critical regression was introduced: the 3:4 aspect-ratio slots at widthPct 52% (n=4) and 55% (n=1) make the active-band balloon vertically, pushing the Time Machine and/or lineup OFF the 800px viewport, and pushing the top row of dancers ABOVE the viewport at n=5/6/8.

ui_bugs.issue: Band height explodes because each slot uses aspectRatio 3/4 with widthPct up to 55%. Measured band heights: n=1=594px, n=3=514px, n=4=1288px, n=5=1074px, n=6=1074px, n=8=808px on a 800px viewport. Content larger than viewport pushes siblings off-screen.
At n=4 TM getBoundingClientRect().top=1213 (viewport is 800) — TM is entirely BELOW the viewport, invisible to user.
At n=1 lineup top=907 (below 800). At n=4 lineup top=1429 (far below). At n=1 lineup is off-screen; at n=4 completely off-screen.

At n=5,6,8 the entire TOP row of dancers sits above the viewport. Row1 tops: n=5=-627, n=6=-627, n=8=-361 (slot heights ~560/400px so bottoms are still above 0 or barely peek in). Only the bottom row is visible to the user.

countText shows 'N / 6 playing' — even after clicking all 8 characters the label reads '6 / 6 playing'. Test still measured 8 char buttons in band, so activation is capped or two characters are aliased. Not part of this iteration's ask but worth flagging.

3.verdict: head OK; band top slightly above viewport but content still visible; TM + lineup visible

4.verdict: HEAD OK but layout catastrophically broken — TM & lineup below viewport

5.verdict: head OK; but top row of dancers entirely above viewport (invisible)

6.verdict: head OK; top row of dancers entirely above viewport

8.verdict: head OK; top row mostly above viewport; only 6/6 activate (see label bug)

head_visibility_table: n=1 PASS | n=3 PASS | n=4 PASS | n=5 PASS | n=6 PASS | n=8 PASS (no character's top is above its parent motion.button top — clip_events=[] at every count)
action_items: The head-clipping fix works and should stay. Do NOT revert the object-contain + 3:4 aspect + negative-margin approach on the horizontal axis.

URGENT: Constrain the active-band's vertical size so it never pushes TM/lineup off-screen. Options: (a) cap band max-height (e.g. calc(100vh - 320px)) so aspect-ratio slots shrink to fit, (b) drop the fixed 3:4 aspect on the slot and use a max-height on the img instead, (c) reduce widthPct/maxW aggressively at multi-row counts so slot height <= (available band height / rows). Current values (52%/480 at n=4, 36%/400 at n=5-6) produce 640/533/400px-tall slots — too tall for 800px viewport once you subtract header/TM/lineup.

Verify at 1280x800: viewport-available band height ≈ 800 - (header ~60 + count-chip ~40 + TM ~220 + lineup ~140 + padding) ≈ 340px. Slot height must be <= 340 for single row, <= 170 for two rows. Currently far exceeded.
Fix the '/ 6 playing' cap: with 8 characters in the lineup users can only activate 6. Either lift the cap to 8 or hide the 7th/8th from lineup.
Retest at n=4 in particular — that's the count where the regression is most catastrophic (TM at y=1213 on an 800px viewport).
critical_code_review_comments: RobotBoogiePage.js line ~693: active-band uses `flex-1 ... overflow-hidden` with a hard `minHeight: 180px` but no `maxHeight`. Combined with children that carry `aspectRatio: 3/4` and up to 55% width, the flex-1 rule does NOT prevent overflow — children dictate min size, forcing the band taller than the viewport at n>=4.

RobotBoogiePage.js line ~369: `aspectRatio: '3 / 4'` on CharacterSlot is head-safe but is the direct cause of the vertical overflow. Consider tying slot height to available band height (via a resize observer or CSS clamp on maxHeight) rather than pure aspect-ratio.
The negative-margin trick works for horizontal closeness at n=4 (measured overlap -60px, matches spec) but doesn't address the taller-slot problem the wider widthPct introduces.
test_credentials: none (used localStorage jma_player_name_skipped_v1='1' + click 'TAP ANYWHERE' to unlock audio)
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reach the game: page.goto('.../#/robot-boogie'); wait; page.evaluate("localStorage.setItem('jma_player_name_skipped_v1','1')"); page.reload(); wait; click 'add my name later' if present; then click 'TAP ANYWHERE' to dismiss audio unlock. Characters are activated by clicking [data-testid="robot-boogie-lineup"] [data-testid="robot-boogie-char-"] where id in {robot1,chunk,jellybone,finn,charlie,lou,jazzy,robot2}. Active count is capped at 6 currently. To measure head clip: for each button in [data-testid=robot-boogie-active-band], compare each visible 's getBoundingClientRect().top to the button's top — img.top must be >= btn.top. To assess TM/lineup visibility, compare their bounding rects to viewport (vh=800).
rca_of_the_issue: The vertical regression is caused by CharacterSlot's fixed `aspectRatio: 3/4` combined with the newly widened widthPct values (55% at n=1, 52% at n=4). Slot height = min(widthPct*bandW, maxW) * 4/3. At 1280x800 → n=4 slot=480x640, two rows=1280px band. The band is `flex-1 flex-wrap` with no max-height, so it grows to fit its children and pushes TM + lineup below the viewport. Head-clipping is fixed because each sprite uses `object-contain object-bottom` inside a slot that no longer clips, but the fix trades a pixel-level clip for a viewport-level overflow. Mitigation: cap slot height (or the band's max-height) so slots shrink when there isn't room. E.g. add `maxHeight: calc((100vh - 400px) / rowsForCount)` or use `maxHeight` on the img while relaxing the slot's fixed aspect ratio.
